subject: Sequoia renewal: performance benchmark request & next steps
messages:
From: Jenna Morris <jenna@sequoia-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sequoia Retail Procurement <procurement@sequoia-retail.com>
Date: 2028-07-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + performance comparison request

Hi Karthik,

We're coming up on our renewal with Redwood in September and procurement has started a parallel evaluation with a competitor. They have asked for a short performance bakeoff focused on latency at 1B tokens/month and cost per 1M tokens for typical retail inference (session length ~68 tokens).

Can your team provide:
- A small benchmark plan we can run against a representative workload (we can provide sample prompts & traffic profile)
- Typical p95 latency numbers for the model variants you recommend at our current quantization profile
- A provisional commercial note showing bandwidth/commit tiers and any renewal incentives you can offer if we commit to a 12–18 month term

Timeline: procurement wants the bakeoff scope and mutual action plan by end-of-week so they can schedule the competitor run next week. We're hopeful to avoid a full rebid but need credible data.

I've attached the current SOW for reference.

Thanks —
Jenna
Jenna Morris
Director, Platform Engineering
Sequoia Retail
[Attachment: Sequoia_Renewal_SOW.pdf (PDF)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna@sequoia-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-15 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + performance comparison request

Hi Jenna —

Thanks for the heads-up and the SOW. We can absolutely run a short, customer-facing benchmark and provide both an apples-to-apples latency/cost readout and a commercial offer aimed at avoiding a rebid. Proposed next steps:

1) We’ll take your sample prompts and traffic profile. If you can drop them in the Drive link you shared, Marcus will template the load harness.
2) Redwood will run three runs over 48 hours (low/medium/high concurrency) and deliver p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost, and a 90-minute replayable artifact.
3) We’ll provide a conservative renewal offer (term and committed throughput) plus an operational guardrail for the first 60 days (burst pool / SLA fallback).

We can share a mutual action plan doc by Friday EOD. I’m looping in Marissa (CS) and Marcus (SE) to scope the harness and timing.

If you want a quick 20m call today to align, I’m available 1:30pm or 3pm PT.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-16 08:22 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Sequoia bakeoff — immediate save plan and deliverables

Team —

Summary: Sequoia (DL-8349) is in renewal window; procurement is running a competitor bakeoff. Jenna asked for a mutual action plan by Friday. This is high risk: they represent ~15% of Q3 committed revenue and the competitor is offering a price-first pitch.

Ask: I need an executable save package we can present that focuses on measurable latency/cost and a commercial incentive to avoid a full RFP. Please comment in the sheet I attached and flag anything that needs legal or finance sign-off.

Proposed save package (initial):
- Technical: 48hr benchmark runs (Marcus) using Sequoia’s prompts and our optimized RTX-quant model variant; produce p50/p95/p99 + token-cost breakdown.
- Operations: 2-week free burst on Dedicated pool during the initial 30 days post-renewal for capacity headroom.
- Commercial: 12-month renewal at a 10% term discount + one-time onboarding credit equal to one week of committed spend. If they commit to 18 months, we’ll move to 14% discount.
- SLA: 99.8% platform uptime and latency SLOs for the seeded model variants for the first 90 days; automatic fallback routing to hosted model variant if Dedicated capacity constrained.

Deliverables & owners:
- Benchmark harness & runs: Marcus (benchmark-plan.xlsx attached)
- Mutual action plan doc & exec summary: Karthik
- Draft commercial term sheet: Neha (needs pricing ops review)
- Legal review for discount guardrail: Neha

Timeline:
- Wed (7/17): Kickoff with Sequoia, get prompts and traffic file.
- Thu–Fri (7/18–7/19): Benchmark runs & analysis.
- Mon (7/20): Present results + signed-term offer ready for signature.

Attachments: save-offer-terms.docx, benchmark-plan.xlsx.

Marissa — can you prep a short CS note on operational onboarding risk and support cadence? Marcus — can you confirm required test infra and whether we need a short-run model quantization change?

Thanks — let’s move fast on this one.

Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna@sequoia-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-20 16:45 -0700
Subject: Sequoia renewal — benchmark results & tailored renewal offer

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for the prompts and profile — we completed the 48-hour runs and attached a short summary. Highlights:
- p95 latency: 324ms (current committed profile)
- Cost: estimated $0.72 per 1k tokens at your projected 1B tokens/month when using 12-month committed tier
- The competitor’s baseline showed similar p50 but higher p95 under burst (we can share side-by-side if helpful)

Attached is a concise mutual action plan and a tailored commercial term sheet. Quick summary of the offer we’d like you to consider:
- 12-month renewal at a 10% term discount from current list rates
- One week onboarding credit equal to estimated weekly committed spend
- 2-week free burst on our Dedicated pool during the first 30 days to ensure zero impact during traffic ramp
- Commitment to run the same benchmark at 90 days as a regression check (we’ll provide replayable artifacts)

If you’re willing to commit to 18 months we can increase to a 14% discount and extend the burst window to 4 weeks. We can put this into DocuSign today — link to the draft term sheet: https://docusign.redwood.com/r/Sequoia-DL8349 (draft, internal)

Next steps:
- If this aligns, I can schedule a 30m exec call for Tuesday (7/23) to walk the exec summary and get procurement feedback.
- Signoff needed from procurement for the term & duration; we’re happy to adjust SLA language to fit your governance.

Please let me know if you want the side-by-side competitor numbers pulled into a single slide.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Sequoia_Benchmark_Summary.pdf (PDF)]
